report: 2019/2019.01.18.DarkHydrus/DarkHydrus delivers new Trojan that can use Google Drive for C2 communications

removed.reason: No evidence of a custom command and control protocol; the text describes using existing protocols (Google Drive API, DNS tunneling) for C2.
No mention of phishing, spearphishing emails, or malicious links.
The text describes C2 data exchange (uploading/downloading commands and identifiers) via Google Drive, not transferring tools or files into the compromised environment.
No mention of gathering system information such as OS, hardware, or patches.
No mention of SMB, Windows admin shares, or remote services.
